# bantu_migration: Understanding the mechanisms behind geographic variations in the rate of the Bantu Expansion

All data and scripts required to reproduce the analysis are located within this repository.


# Folder and File Structure

* the `/input` folder contains all inputs (such as vegetation shapefiles) required for the analysis
* the `/scripts` folder contains all R-code produced in the context of this research
* the `/data` folder contains the data require to reproduce the analysis
* the `/output` folder contains all outputs generated by the scripts
